gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-huninn: Woodgod looks vintage and commanding, with tall lowercase nearly touching its capitals. Huninn follows in a modern sans-serif whose crossbars are as fat as its stems, so a long page reads like ballpoint ink, smooth and unfussy.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight reads modern and compact, its ascenders barely clearing the lowercase. Under Woodgod's vintage, commanding display letters, a long stretch of sans text moves along like smooth tubing, tidy and steady, never fussing at the eye.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-karla: Approachable is the first word for Karla, but Woodgod sets the tone above it, commanding and vintage. Karla keeps a gaping c opening and a tall middle band, so a long stretch of sans-serif text looks stocky, friendly and easy going.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-kedebideri: Approachable rounded forms define Kedebideri, with a skyward x-height under Woodgod's commanding, vintage display. Kedebideri is a sans-serif that welcomes a body size on the generous side, since its open letters stay inviting there.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-krub: Woodgod is vintage and commanding, with a wide channel into every bowl. Its tall lowercase earns its keep big and short, while Krub, a contemporary sans-serif with pen-lifted curves, handles the quieter work beneath.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-kufam: Tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals gives Woodgod its swagger. Kufam answers it with a neon-tube monoline in a clean sans, and that gap between vintage heft and slim, open curves is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-lexend: Big, brash and vintage, Woodgod leads with a wide channel into every bowl. Lexend, an approachable sans-serif with outsized lowercase and open jaws, offers the pair's strongest quality: a fixed-pen line against that display weight.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-lexend-deca: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage voice, with tall lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals. And Lexend Deca, a clean sans with unshaded poured lines and terminals that stop short, keeps a long stretch of text moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-liter: Commanding Woodgod sets a vintage tone with its tall lowercase and wide bowls. Liter then carries a long passage as a modern sans-serif with no stroke contrast at all, its round forms wide mouthed and tidy like drafting-pen lines.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-mada: Tall, stern and vintage, Woodgod opens with a wide channel into every bowl. Mada follows as an approachable sans whose towering midzone and curves that refuse to close make a long passage feel modern and easy going.
